metadata.title: Mid-Century Modern Vocal Group Album Cover

retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s-style album layout featuring a group portrait integrated with a grid of primary-colored geometric rectangles and clean, stacked sans-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, studio-lit group portrait of five performers in formal attire, set against a white background punctuated by a Mondrian-inspired grid of red, yellow, and blue rectangles that serve as both floor tiles and floating background elements.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject figures overlapping geometric color blocks
Right-aligned stacked typography balancing left-weighted group portrait
Primary color palette (red, yellow, blue) against a neutral white field
Formal attire (suits and evening gown) contrasting with abstract geometry

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group of five people occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, standing at full-length scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central female figure in a white gown acts as the vertical anchor between the male group and the text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the group on the left, moves across the large blue title text, and descends through the stacked magenta subtitle and tracklist on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space in the upper right and lower center provides breathing room for the layout.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-saturation primary colors against a high-value white background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying weights and colors to create hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, mid-century Swiss style of the era.
Provides the geometric circularity seen in the 'O' and 'G' characters.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio photograph of a 1960s vocal group (four men in light blue silk suits, one woman in a white beaded gown) standing on a white floor. Integrate large, flat rectangles of red, yellow, and blue into the scene as floor tiles and background wall elements.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add right-aligned, stacked uppercase text in a geometric sans-serif font. Use blue for the main title and magenta for the secondary title. Place a list of track names in smaller black sans-serif text below.

verificationChecks: Are the primary colors (Red, Blue, Yellow) present in geometric blocks?
Is the font a clean, monolinear sans-serif?
Do the subjects overlap the color blocks?

adjustableVariables: Specific hue of the magenta text
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and track titles

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on all geometric shapes
High-key studio lighting with soft shadows

postGenerationChecks: Check that the blue title is the largest text element.
Ensure the color blocks do not obscure the faces of the subjects.
Verify that the background remains predominantly white.
Confirm the typography is strictly sans-serif.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject Group + Geometric Color Grid + Stacked Right-Aligned Sans-Serif = Mid-Century Modern Album Aesthetic
